nodes.Name: Options
nodes.DocComment: Options control the NIT serialisation detail level.

nodes.Name: DefaultOptions
nodes.DocComment: DefaultOptions are calibrated for minimal-token LLM prompts.

nodes.Name: Serialize
nodes.DocComment:
Serialize converts a Module into its NIT representation.
Each element of the returned slice is one output line.
The caller can join them with "\n" for a single string.

nodes.Name: SerializeToString
nodes.DocComment: SerializeToString returns the NIT output as a single newline-joined string.

nodes.Name: TokenEstimate
nodes.DocComment:
TokenEstimate returns a rough token count for the serialised output.
Uses a conservative 4-chars-per-token heuristic (GPT/Claude tokenisers).

Children.Name: case
Children.RawSource: ast.NodeFunction, ast.NodeMethod, ast.NodeStruct, ast.NodeClass, ast.NodeInterface, ast.NodeEnum, ast.NodeVariable, ast.NodeConstant, ast.NodeTypeAlias

nodes.Name: formatReturns
nodes.DocComment: formatReturns produces " T" or " (T1,T2)" or "" for no returns.

nodes.Name: collectCallees
nodes.DocComment: collectCallees walks children recursively and collects unique callee names.

nodes.Name: lastSegment
nodes.DocComment: lastSegment returns the last path segment of an import path.
